ModMetaData.name: Better Work Tab
ModMetaData.author: Coolnether123
ModMetaData.description: Better Work Tab v2.0 adds drag-and-drop ordering, skill overlays, automation rules, sub-work jobs, time priority schedules, extended priorities, and visual customization to RimWorld's Work tab. You can toggle features in settings. Features - Drag and drop work column and pawn row reordering - Priority ranges from vanilla's 4 levels up to 99 - Specific-job view with shared and pawn-specific priorities - Time-of-day priority schedules for work and sub-work jobs - Skill level overlay (hold SHIFT) - Auto-assignment rulesets - Workload presets - Visual dividers - Force pawns to work on unassigned tasks - Advanced pawn and column highlighting - Angled or vanilla-style column headers - Colonist and bed counts - Right-click pawn quick actions - Multiplayer support for supported versions with Zetrith Multiplayer - Settings for UI, priorities, rules, workloads, and layout - Optional Fluffy-style layout with right-expanding specific jobs. It uses installed Fluffy icons for top controls. Without Fluffy, you can enable BWT's text substitutes, which are off by default Compatibility - Compatible with most work-type mods - [FSF] Complex Jobs column ordering is supported - Vanilla Skills Expanded passion types are supported in rule conditions when the mod is active - Do Once - Noncommittal Work is compatible. BWT suppresses its duplicate borrowed menu patches and uses BWT's specific-job-aware version - Useful Marks markers appear on pawn icons when available - Grouped Pawns List is overridden inside this Work tab - CompactWorkTab overlaps this UI and should not be used together - Fluffy Work Tab and forks can coexist, with one Work tab active at a time Credits and licensing - Fluffy's Work Tab by Fluffy inspired the Fluffy-style layout and remains supported as an optional compatibility target - Fluffy Work Tab software and documentation are MIT licensed. Its art and sounds are not bundled with BWT - Full notices: https://github.com/coolnether123/Better-Work-Tab/blob/Dev/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md Version support - 1.6 -> v2.0 - 1.5 -> v2.0 - 1.4 -> v2.0 - 1.3 -> v2.0 - 1.2 -> v2.0 - Multiplayer does not work - 1.1 -> v2.0 - Multiplayer does not work - 1.0 -> v2.0 - Multiplayer does not work - 0.19 -> v2.0 - Multiplayer does not work - 0.18 -> v2.0 - Multiplayer does not work - 0.17 -> v2.0 - Multiplayer does not work - 0.16 -> v2.0 - Multiplayer does not work - 0.15 -> v2.0 - Multiplayer does not work - 0.14 -> v2.0 - Multiplayer does not work - 0.13 -> v2.0 - Multiplayer does not work - Alpha 4 / 0.4 -> v2.0 - Multiplayer does not work Support Questions, bug reports, or suggestions?
